clauses.reason: Section 1 requires that, whenever the Secretary of the Treasury enters into an agreement under 5 U.S.C. 5516, 5517 or 5520 with the District of Columbia, a State, a city or a county on withholding income or employment taxes from the pay of Federal employees and members of the Armed Forces, the Secretary ensure that each agreement is consistent with those sections and with the regulations, including this order. The current regulation text of 31 CFR 215.6 shows agreements being made pursuant to the order. No held instrument ends or amends it. Operative on 2026-10-14.

clauses.reason: Section 4 authorizes the Secretary of the Treasury to prescribe additional regulations to implement 5 U.S.C. 5516, 5517 and 5520 and the order. 31 CFR Part 215 (current eCFR text) carries the order as one of its authorities and 31 CFR 215.12 makes the agreements subject to rules issued under it. The first sentence of Section 5 revokes Executive Order No. 11968 of January 31, 1977. The order has no later effective-date provision, so the revocation took effect when the order was signed on June 22, 1977, and the command was executed that day. The end is cited to the held order text, which ends with the date 'June 22, 1977'.

clauses.reason: The second sentence of Section 5 keeps in effect, except where inconsistent with the order, all actions, regulations and approved agreements in force when the order issued, until amended, modified or revoked pursuant to the authority the order confers, unless sooner terminated by operation of law. Its own terms give no end date, and the held sources show no instrument amending, modifying or revoking the preserved actions as a class; the Code note still prints the sentence. Which individual preserved actions still exist is not shown by held sources, so the clause is recorded as operative and described as a standing savings rule, not as proof that any particular action survives. Operative on 2026-10-14.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text (42 FR 31759, June 23, 1977; jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11997.txt) is Executive Order 11997 of June 22, 1977, Withholding of District of Columbia, State, City and County Income or Employment Taxes, issued under 5 U.S.C. 5516, 5517 and 5520 and 3 U.S.C. 301. Inventory: Sections 1 to 5 as in the dossier, except that Section 5 is split into its sentence revoking Executive Order 11968 (a command executed on issuance) and its savings sentence (continuing); the clause list is therefore restated by override. Later instruments: none was found. The OFR catalog search returned 0 hits; the U.S. Code note carries no amendment note; the eCFR texts of 31 CFR 215.6 and 215.12 (amended through 2026-11-06; custody records without held bytes, cited as leads only) still name the order as the basis of the agreements between the Secretary of the Treasury and the States, cities and counties. The authority statutes 5 U.S.C. 5516, 5517 and 5520 are named in those current regulation texts. Own terms: the only 'until' wording is in the Section 5 savings sentence ('until amended, modified, or revoked pursuant to the authority conferred by this Order'), which continues pre-existing actions and ends nothing in the order. Coverage notes read: U.S. Code through 2026-10-09 only; eCFR as of 2026-10-14; OFR catalog and saved texts checked 2026-11-25.
